messages.author: 48d7185da1ab0f7e
messages.subject: Variational inference in PyStan
parts:
Hello,

From PyStan 2.7 release notes I see that variational inference should be available. However, I couldn't find any information on how to use it.

Any help would much appreciated.

Thank you,
Pedro.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Variational inference in PyStan
parts:
I don't think it made it into 2.7 or will make it into 2.8.
We're still working on getting the more robust application
tested and into the core C++ version of Stan. The RStan team
wasn't comfortable releasing until adaptation got better, so
for now, it's only in CmdStan.

- Bob

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Variational inference in PyStan

experimental there are some missing pieces which are still needed to
allow PyStan to smoothly use the new code.
